scoring_justification: Checker recomputes transverse modulus and ultimate tensile strength from raw stress-strain data and compares to paper-reported values plus structural ordering, fulfilling T1 recompute.

outputs.description: Stress-strain curves for three interphase configurations (PG, GV_all, GV_half). The checker recomputes transverse modulus and ultimate tensile strength from these data.

output_contract.notes: The agent must carry out all process steps to generate the provided stress-strain data. The checker extracts properties and compares them to hidden reference values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold moduli and strengths for PG, GV_all, GV_half interphase configurations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: 'Current Model – GV Displacing All the Polymer', 'Current Model – GV Displacing Half the Polymer', 'Current Model – PG' rows.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values converted to GPa (strength from MPa) as specified in the output contract; taken directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reference results the agent must reproduce within tolerance; they are the paper's own headline interphase mechanical properties.
